content.title: Return Reason Form
content.description: Please select the reason for returning your item. We're here to help!

reason_codes.label: We didn't quite get it right - our sizing was off.

sub_reasons.label: The item was too small for me.
The item was too large for me.

sub_reasons.label: The item pilled or frayed excessively.
The item shrunk after washing.
The item had an unpleasant odour.

sub_reasons.label: The dye bled or ran excessively.
The item faded quickly.
The colour didn't match the description.

reason_codes.label: We're sorry to hear that the style or design wasn't quite right for you.

sub_reasons.label: The item didn't flatter my figure.
The item had poor construction or finishing.
The item wasn't suitable for the occasion I needed it for.

The threads were tangled or uneven.
The texture was uncomfortable to wear.

reason_codes.label: We understand that the embroidery or printing wasn't quite right.

sub_reasons.label: The design was incorrect or not what I expected.
The embroidery or printing quality was poor.
Some elements were missing or misaligned.

reason_codes.label: We're sorry to hear that the finishing wasn't quite right.
